source: Fremond et al. 2026, physical PDF pp.9-10, Eqs.8-11 and communication-loss section; paper/REPRODUCTION.md
reconstruction_choices: This module is perception only. It changes no truth position, altitude, velocity, accepted target, lock, waypoint, action queue or simulator state. Sensor missing/aberrant/falsified modes and noncooperative traffic are outside this implementation.

At each global 5 s decision, sort stable aircraft IDs and make one categorical none/position/communication selection per aircraft in the supplied full physical snapshot, including aircraft already in a communication blackout. p_position+p_communication must not exceed one. Persistent blackout can hide a newly drawn position error.

Both probabilities default to zero. This path consumes neither the private perturbation RNG nor any global/external RNG and preserves each supplied AircraftState instance. The snapshot mapping is an immutable sorted view of these references, not the caller's mutable mapping object.

Use an explicitly seeded private NumPy Generator(PCG64). For each sorted aircraft, draw category first, then two independent normal EN components for a position event or one inverse-CDF uniform for communication duration. With sigma=0, a position event consumes its category draw but no normal draw and returns the original state exactly.

The independent two-axis EN Gaussian is an explicit reconstruction choice: the paper does not fully specify its two-dimensional distribution. Default sigma=9.63 m follows Eq.11/text; 4.59 m is the alternate disclosed precision setting. Table1's 9.33 discrepancy is not silently substituted.

Convert the EN vector to an initial compass bearing and geodesic arc length on a sphere of radius 6371000 m. Preserve actual altitude and every other AircraftState field. Nonzero shifts whose starting or resulting point lies within pole_guard_degrees of a geographic pole are rejected; zero displacement is an exact identity even at a pole.

Communication duration is 5/10/15 s with probabilities .25/.50/.25. Trigger before availability is formed and set until=max(previous_until,t+duration). Information recovers from the current physical snapshot; no stale observation or old action is replayed.

Availability intervals are half-open [start,until). Overlapping or exactly touching blackouts form one continuous segment. A retrigger means the aircraft was already unavailable strictly before this trigger (t<old_until); a trigger exactly at expiry can extend the segment without inventing a positive-duration recovery gap.

Only the latest decision snapshot is cached. Time starts at 0 after reset; a new call must be at the same time with identical physical state values or exactly 5 s later. Reordered mappings reuse the cache. Skipped/reversed decisions and changed same-time inputs raise instead of fabricating missing draws or returning stale data.

Snapshot.encode calls the existing observe using only available aircraft. A missing ownship therefore has no encoded observation here. Its control, transition, log-probability and GAE treatment belongs to the future driver and is not claimed implemented by this module.

availability_at is a read-only query of registered communication intervals, independent of physical presence. Unknown IDs have no registered blackout. Future queries assume only currently registered events; they do not predict or sample future triggers. The driver must separately track real admission/deletion and integrate actual physical intervals.

Statistics distinguish eligible aircraft-decisions, each event type, active retriggers, continuous-blackout segment starts and currently unavailable aircraft at the latest decision. No flight-hours or aircraft-seconds are inferred from decision snapshots.

Checkpoint state contains primitive JSON data, full configuration identity, NumPy/PCG64 state, clock, interval history and cached truth/sensed snapshots. Load validates their consistency atomically. Python object identity cannot be preserved across JSON serialization, but values and subsequent draws are restored.

Candidate p_position=.009 and p_communication=.003 can be calculated from 6.48 and 2.16 events per flight-hour divided by 720 five-second opportunities. These are unconfirmed rate-to-probability reconstructions, not author-confirmed defaults, and overlapping triggers further separate trigger rates from unavailable duration.
